fallbackAttempt.text:
What this is
This is a fake delivery message pretending to be from a fictional company called Northstar Parcel. It claims your package will be returned unless you pay a small fee right away. I could not independently verify its claims because I have no web sources and the page content is untrusted.

Why I think so
The page uses false urgency by giving you only thirty minutes to act. It also asks for your credit card details and uses a hidden link address.

What to do now
Do not enter your card details or personal information. Leave the page immediately and delete the message.
